title: Get Rid of Bacteria & Pet Odor from Your Washer
body_text:
You can’t see it, but your washer could be hiding dangerous bacteria, mold, and buildup that transfer onto your clothes and into the air you breathe. To solve similar problems in space, NASA developed powerful enzyme technology that breaks down organic grime at a microscopic level. Now, that same breakthrough is packed into Uproot Washing Machine Cleaner Tabs.
 It’s not just about clean laundry, it’s about protecting your lungs, your skin, and your health. Clean your machine with NASA-inspired enzyme power and feel fresher every day.
